events.label: DKFZ study on obesity and cancer risk

slots.name: study cohort size
slots.sentence: Data from 458,543 women and men from the UK Biobank , which holds one of the world's biggest health datasets, were included in the study.

slots.name: follow-up duration
slots.sentence: The participants were followed for and average of 12 years, during which 50,000 new cases of cancer were identified.

slots.name: identified cancer cases
slots.sentence: The participants were followed for and average of 12 years, during which 50,000 new cases of cancer were identified.

slots.name: analysis lag
slots.sentence: Only cancer cases that occurred seven years after the start of the observation period were considered — and that made the statistical link between being overweight and cancer clearer.

slots.name: associated cancer types
slots.sentence: Being overweight or obese significantly increases the risk of developing colon cancer, breast cancer or liver cancer, and is a major risk factor for 10 other types of cancer, a new study has found.
